name: Reachability Source
description: The source role of the reachability compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): the VPC edge an Amazon Inspector v2 network-reachability finding says traffic enters by -> the finding, the middle node. A role name, the official exception to <ACTION>_<OBJECT> (the middle node carries the action); the source is the initiator. The sources are a closed list of the gateways AWS documents as the edges Inspector evaluates (an internet gateway, including instances behind an Application Load Balancer, a VPC peering connection, a VPN through a virtual private gateway; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-types.html), each named by its own id or ARN read from the finding's networkPath.steps. The finding retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py (aws-core-tap#261).
